dedupe_keys.name: a multi modal dataset for learning based morphology informed building performance modeling

description: A multi-modal dataset for learning-based morphology-informed building performance modeling is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sarah Mokhtar et al. Building performance, including airflow and radiative exchanges, is governed by morphology. High-fidelity simulations are accurate but computationally expensive, limiting their use in design workflows. Data-driven approaches provide a scalable alternative, yet their development remains constrained by the absence of high-quality datasets that pair geometrically expressive 3D models with validated physical simulation outputs. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2026. Formats: ZIP. The data are held in Harvard Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 392074759250. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
